purpose: CI-only project split; exact runtime/science/browser preservation

.github/workflows/validate.yml.beforeText:
name: Validate catalog

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check JavaScript syntax
        run: |
          node --check app.js
          node --check analytics.js
          node --check theories.js
          node --check formulas.js
          node --check formula-audit.js
          node --check developments.js
          node --check questions.js
          node --check problems.js
          node --check evidence.js
          node --check passports.js
          node --check profiles.js
          node --check workspace.js
          node --check sourced-paths.js
          node --check research-navigation.js
      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Test navigation and catalog regressions
        run: npm test
      - name: Verify generated coverage
        run: |
          node scripts/coverage-report.mjs --check
          node scripts/freshness-report.mjs --check
          node scripts/version-assets.mjs --check
      - name: Validate theory graph
        run: node scripts/validate-data.mjs
      - name: Verify static entry point
        run: |
          test -f index.html
          test -f analytics.js
          test -f styles.css
          test -f developments.js
          test -f questions.js
          test -f problems.js
          test -f evidence.js
          test -f passports.js
          grep -q './theories.js' index.html
          grep -q './developments.js' index.html
          grep -q './questions.js' index.html
          grep -q './problems.js' index.html
          grep -q './evidence.js' index.html
          grep -q './passports.js' index.html
          grep -q './app.js' index.html
          grep -q './analytics.js' index.html
          grep -q './formulas.js' index.html
          grep -q './formula-audit.js' index.html
          grep -q './profiles.js' index.html
          grep -q 'id="formulaView"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="formulaGrid"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="thoughtTreeGraph"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="treeGraphTitle"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="timelineLayer"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="timelineEventType"' index.html
          grep -q 'function renderThoughtTreeGraph' app.js

  map-diagnostic:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.63.0-noble@sha256:72bd171a9ffc2b4b59532aaa6210e21014d07093120dc25528870c0b840da1f0
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Verify pinned browser environment
        run: |
          python3 --version
          node --version
          node -e "const p=require('@playwright/test'); if(require('@playwright/test/package.json').version!=='1.63.0') throw Error('Update the pinned CI image with Playwright'); for(const name of ['chromium','webkit']) {const file=p[name].executablePath(); if(!require('node:fs').existsSync(file)) throw Error('Missing preinstalled '+name+': '+file); console.log(name+': '+file);}"
      - name: Exercise map gestures before the full catalog suite
        run: npx playwright test tests/browser/map-interactions.spec.mjs --repeat-each=2 --retries=0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: map-diagnostic-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14

  qa-diagnostic:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.63.0-noble@sha256:72bd171a9ffc2b4b59532aaa6210e21014d07093120dc25528870c0b840da1f0
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Verify pinned browser environment
        run: |
          python3 --version
          node --version
          node -e "const p=require('@playwright/test'); if(require('@playwright/test/package.json').version!=='1.63.0') throw Error('Update the pinned CI image with Playwright'); for(const name of ['chromium','webkit']) {const file=p[name].executablePath(); if(!require('node:fs').existsSync(file)) throw Error('Missing preinstalled '+name+': '+file); console.log(name+': '+file);}"
      - name: Exercise files filters and analytics before the full catalog suite
        run: npx playwright test tests/browser/workspace-files.spec.mjs tests/browser/filter-controls.spec.mjs tests/browser/analytics.spec.mjs tests/browser/branch-return.spec.mjs --retries=0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: qa-diagnostic-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14

  browser:
    needs: [map-diagnostic, qa-diagnostic]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.63.0-noble@sha256:72bd171a9ffc2b4b59532aaa6210e21014d07093120dc25528870c0b840da1f0
    # Full-catalog MathJax checks plus per-record Chromium/WebKit provenance tests.
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Verify pinned browser environment
        run: |
          python3 --version
          node --version
          node -e "const p=require('@playwright/test'); if(require('@playwright/test/package.json').version!=='1.63.0') throw Error('Update the pinned CI image with Playwright'); for(const name of ['chromium','webkit']) {const file=p[name].executablePath(); if(!require('node:fs').existsSync(file)) throw Error('Missing preinstalled '+name+': '+file); console.log(name+': '+file);}"
      - run: npm run test:browser
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: browser-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14

  package:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: [validate, browser]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: read
    outputs:
      workflow_pages: ${{ steps.pages.outputs.workflow_pages }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check Pages publishing source
        id: pages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          mode=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pages" --jq .build_type)
          if [ "$mode" = workflow ]; then
            echo "workflow_pages=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "workflow_pages=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Pages still uses branch publishing. Select Settings > Pages > Source > GitHub Actions to activate the tested-artifact deployment gate." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Package the tested revision
        run: |
          mkdir _site
          cp index.html styles.css theories.js formulas.js formula-audit.js developments.js questions.js problems.js evidence.js passports.js profiles.js workspace.js sourced-paths.js research-navigation.js app.js analytics.js _site/
          cp -R docs _site/docs
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > _site/revision.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    needs: package
    if: needs.package.outputs.workflow_pages == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: pages
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        id: deployment
